hooks.text: The United States once ignored a fine for littering across Australia.
Why did American radio listeners pay an Australian littering fine for NASA?
A four-hundred-dollar littering fine once went unpaid by NASA for decades.

title: The Day NASA Got a Ticket for Littering
description: When the Skylab space station fell on Australia in 1979, NASA received a real littering ticket that took thirty years to pay.

beats.text: The United States once ignored a fine for littering across Australia.
beats.visual: NASA photograph of the Skylab space station in Earth orbit, 1974

beats.text: Many believe America's first space station, Skylab, was safely steered into the deep ocean.
beats.visual: NASA photograph of Skylab launch on the Saturn V rocket, 1973

beats.text: But in July nineteen seventy-nine, the massive station plummeted through the atmosphere as a fireball.
beats.visual: Artist concept of a spacecraft burning up during atmospheric reentry

beats.text: Controllers tried to guide it, but a miscalculation sent flaming debris raining over Western Australia.
beats.visual: Map showing the Skylab reentry debris path across Australia and the Indian Ocean, 1979

beats.text: Large fragments crashed near the town of Esperance, landing on private properties and roofs.
beats.visual: Photograph of a large Skylab oxygen tank debris recovered from the Australian outback, 1979

beats.text: Local officials weren't impressed and issued NASA a real four-hundred-dollar ticket for littering.
beats.visual: Close-up of the original $400 littering fine document issued by the Shire of Esperance, 1979

beats.text: NASA ignored the administrative bill for decades until a California radio show heard the story.
beats.visual: Photograph of a professional radio broadcasting studio microphone

beats.text: In two thousand nine, loyal listeners raised the cash and finally settled the astronomical debt.
beats.visual: Photograph of Skylab debris displayed at the Esperance Municipal Museum

beats.text: It was a strange end for the station that was fined for littering across Australia.
beats.visual: Photograph of the Skylab space station against the black background of space, 1974

better_than_last: Implemented a stronger curiosity-gap hook by leading with a specific fine rather than a general mission summary.
